alternatives.mechanism: Implement a voluntary micro‑donation system where mentees can tip mentors after each session, with the platform taking a small processing fee.
addresses_issues: Lack of sustainable revenue model if platform remains free
Assuming a symbolic fee will meaningfully increase user commitment
Potential exclusion of low‑income users due to fee
tradeoffs: Revenue becomes unpredictable and depends on user generosity
May create social pressure on mentees to tip
Requires handling of payment processing and potential disputes
alternatives.novelty_or_difference: Introduces post‑session tipping rather than upfront subscription, aligning payment with perceived value.

alternatives.mechanism: Create a skill‑based credit system: mentors earn credits for each mentorship hour, mentees earn credits by contributing community resources (articles, workshops), and credits can be purchased or exchanged for premium features.
addresses_issues: Lack of sustainable revenue model if platform remains free
Assuming a symbolic fee will meaningfully increase user commitment
Potential exclusion of low‑income users due to fee
tradeoffs: Adds complexity in tracking and balancing credit economy
Risk of credit inflation or gaming the system
Requires moderation of contributed content for quality
alternatives.novelty_or_difference: Links mentorship activity and community contributions to a tradable credit economy, reducing direct monetary barriers.

alternatives.mechanism: Form partnerships with corporate sponsors to fund premium mentorship tracks; sponsors provide branded content and may supply paid mentor time, while the base matching service remains free for all users.
addresses_issues: Lack of sustainable revenue model if platform remains free
Potential exclusion of low‑income users due to fee
tradeoffs: Potential perception of bias toward sponsor‑backed mentors
Possible introduction of advertising or branded experiences
alternatives.novelty_or_difference: Leverages external sponsorship to subsidize premium features without charging end users directly.
